title: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Net Metering Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive Systems) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2020
printed_date: 2020-01-22 per landing page (document body prints no date on extracted text)

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Provided that the cumulative capacity to be allowed at a particular distribution transformer shall not exceed capacity of the distribution transformer;

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: Provided that the cumulative capacity to be allowed at a particular distribution transformer shall not exceed 65% of the peak capacity of the distribution transformer;

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Amended Reg 6.2 (residential and MSME exempt from cap)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: and MSME (Manufacturing) Enterprise shall be upto a maximum of 50% of consumer’s sanctioned load/contract demand; whereas in case of Residential Consumers

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: whereas in case of Residential Consumers, the Rooftop Solar PV System capacity shall be irrespective of their sanctioned load/contract demand.

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The main Solar Meter and Net Meter shall be of 1.0 and 0.5S or better class accuracy
